uv run pytest -q -n auto --dist loadscope tests/test_api tests/test_registry

deviations.what: Existing tests that read samples or measurements of a public dataset now build it with published=True: the fixtures in tests/test_api (conftest public_dataset and the single-line DatasetFactory calls in test_filters, test_serializers and test_viewsets, and the a_record_in fixture in test_permissions) and two tests in demo/tests/test_api_smoke.py. Assertions are unchanged.
deviations.why: The dataset factory leaves published unset, and samples and measurements of a public, unpublished dataset are no longer public. It is named in progress.md under T061.

deviations.what: test_fairdm_api_title_is_overrideable and test_fairdm_api_description_is_overrideable in tests/test_api/test_settings.py are replaced by test_the_title_is_changed_through_spectacular_settings and test_the_description_is_changed_through_spectacular_settings, which read the generated schema.
deviations.why: The old pair set a setting and read it back. The new pair patch drf-spectacular's loaded settings, because replacing SPECTACULAR_SETTINGS through the settings fixture does not reach the schema.

deviations.what: T063's visibility check for a many-to-many to a record type is primed for the whole page (RecordReferenceField.prime takes the relation's name, and RecordListSerializer calls it), which the task text does not list.
deviations.why: Without it a list of samples with a declared many-to-many to samples read one query per related record, which T066 exists to prevent. A count test in TestReferencesFollowTheLists failed at 24 queries against 15 before it.

deviations.what: The contributors a list leaves out are read once per request and kept on the serializer context, and the shared rule is FairDMVisibilityFilter.hidden_contributors.
deviations.why: Checking each credit separately made lists of datasets, projects, samples and contributors run a query per credit; the query-count tests caught it.

deviations.what: The sample description and date filters use PartialDateFilter, imported from the measurement filter set, rather than only changing the field names.
deviations.why: SampleDate.value is a partial date, and a plain DateFilter's date value is refused against it; changing only the names still answered 500 for date_after.

deviations.what: T061's visitor case for a write is answered 401, not 404; the write test uses a signed-in person with no level.
deviations.why: A write by a visitor needs a sign-in first, so it cannot reach the 404.

deviations.what: No test for a project whose owner is a superuser.
deviations.why: Project.owner must be an organisation and organisations are never left out of the contributor list, so the case cannot arise.

concerns: ruff check run without --no-fix rewrites unrelated test files in this repository (eleven files changed in one run, reverted before committing). It is easy to commit unrelated edits by accident.

A many-to-many to a record type read from a custom serializer that is not built by the registry is primed only when its field is a RecordReferenceField(many=True) on a RecordListSerializer; a custom viewset must apply fairdm.api.viewsets.load_relations to its own queryset (documented on the API page).
